verdict.rationale: Notion's first-party MCP documentation says it can search content in Notion and connected sources, and the marketing page promises instant answers with citations. That confirms a native search capability exists. A community user says 'Search still needs some love', which is general criticism rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence but does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: documented coverage of comments and tasks in search, any evidence of speed or accuracy, in-app search documentation beyond the MCP tool list, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can search across all tasks, docs, and comments and get fast, accurate results

citations.quote: Search content in Notion and connected sources.
